svg.title: FoveaWAM architecture
svg.desc: Publication publication refinement v21, preserving the approved v18 design. Reference layout: WorldBridge Fig.3 and SelfWAM Fig.2; whole-layer repetition follows LAW Fig.5; execution views follow the bottom-right of Faster-WAM Fig.2. Scene S and Summary M retain distinct states but share World normalization and FFN weights. Action A has its own flow-time-conditioned AdaLN and FFN. QKV and output projection weights are shared across S/M/A. Shared attention obeys S-to-S, M-to-S/M, A-to-S/M/A masks. Two residual additions and layer input/output states are shown. The bracket repeats the complete coupled layer; multiplicities are schematic. Flow time u conditions Action AdaLN before attention and before FFN, not World. Training uses differentiable World conditioning and supervises World readouts and Action velocity. Inference computes World once per query, stores S/M attention-input K/V per layer, and iterates only Action. Geometric examples are recorded supervision references; decoded geometry is not an Action input. RGB and flow context are Blender renderings of the recorded frame-29 state; depth remains recorded. Flow annotations, diagram structure and text remain editable vectors. The context meshes are editable in the accompanying Blender scene.
